paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者读完一篇故事后，先想到人物没有说出口的理由，后来看到新线索又改了理解。提出几种解释、哪条有证据及是否愿意继续想，是不同问题。均分不证明解释准确或大脑加工更深；可以保留一个开放问题，也不必为了“深度”延长不愿继续的思考。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader considers an unstated motive after a story and revises the interpretation when a new clue appears. Possible explanations, supporting evidence and willingness to keep thinking differ. A mean establishes neither accuracy nor deeper brain processing. One question can remain open without extending unwanted thinking to demonstrate depth.

title.en: Explain the time you actually need
title.zh: 说明你实际需要的时间

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“哪条观察支持当前理解，哪些还是猜测，现在是否愿意继续想？”可以只讨论虚构读者，将观察、解释及未知分开。愿意参与的人可以不同意或停止；无需展示答案、私信或身份，不以讨论证明更敏感、更在乎或更有能力。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which observation supports the current interpretation, what remains a guess, and is further reflection wanted now?” Discuss only the fictional reader, separating observations, interpretations and unknowns. Willing participants can disagree or stop without showing answers, messages or identities. Discussion need not demonstrate greater sensitivity, care or ability.

title.zh: 怎样读较少发生和资料不足

Means determine no HSP identity, diagnosis, sensory threshold, perceptual accuracy, brain mechanism, career fit or relationship match. Read alone or discuss fictional people without private affairs, personal values or sensory exposure; decline discussion freely. title.en: Change one part of a familiar task
title.zh: 只调整熟悉任务的一部分

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者跟着一项熟悉任务操作时，几条可关闭的通知同时出现，后来不确定做到哪一步。通知、指示与实际中断可以分别记录；一次环境调整不能验证敏感体质，也不证明通知造成所有困难。只考虑自己能决定的安全调整，不必尝试更强刺激或要求别人接受标签。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader follows a familiar task when several optional notifications appear and later loses track of the step. Notifications, instructions and the observed interruption can be recorded separately. One adjustment verifies no sensitivity identity and proves no cause of every difficulty. Consider only safe changes within one’s control, without stronger stimuli or requiring anyone to accept a label.

title.en: Make a usable request for a pause

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“哪些信息同时出现，哪一步实际变难，是否有一个自愿且可撤回的调整？”可以只讨论虚构读者，将观察、解释及未知分开。愿意参与的人可以不同意或停止；无需展示答案、私信或身份，不以讨论证明更敏感、更在乎或更有能力。

Willing participants can disagree or stop without showing answers, messages or identities. Discussion need not demonstrate greater sensitivity, care or ability.

title.en: Notice a response without reading a mind
title.zh: 留意自己的反应，不替别人读心

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者听到朋友得到好消息，自己也很高兴，但还不知道朋友想庆祝还是安静休息。自己的情绪、对方说过的话和对方希望怎样回应可以分开；共鸣不等于读心。可自愿问一句想要什么支持，也可只表示祝贺，不以均分比较谁更关心或要求回报。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader feels happy at a friend’s good news without knowing whether the friend wants celebration or quiet rest. Personal feelings, the friend’s words and wanted responses differ; resonance is not mind-reading. A voluntary question about support or a simple congratulation is possible without comparing care through means or demanding a response in return.

title.en: Check what connection means to each person
title.zh: 核对彼此怎样理解连接

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“自己感受到什么，对方实际说了什么，哪种支持是否受欢迎仍需询问？”可以只讨论虚构读者，将观察、解释及未知分开。愿意参与的人可以不同意或停止；无需展示答案、私信或身份，不以讨论证明更敏感、更在乎或更有能力。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What was personally felt, what did the other person actually say, and which support still needs an invitation?” Discuss only the fictional reader, separating observations, interpretations and unknowns. Willing participants can disagree or stop without showing answers, messages or identities. Discussion need not demonstrate greater sensitivity, care or ability.

paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader notices a changed line on an event poster without knowing whether timing or arrangements changed. The visible words, possible meanings and checkable plans differ. Noticing proves no greater accuracy or entitlement to another person’s intentions. Check public information only when useful, without making every difference a task to resolve.

title.en: Offer a detail in a useful form
title.zh: 把细节说成可使用的信息

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“具体哪一处变了，是否影响当前安排，哪些含义仍没有依据？”可以只讨论虚构读者，将观察、解释及未知分开。愿意参与的人可以不同意或停止；无需展示答案、私信或身份，不以讨论证明更敏感、更在乎或更有能力。

Willing participants can disagree or stop without showing answers, messages or identities. Discussion need not demonstrate greater sensitivity, care or ability.
